reason: B takes it: at 390px it reflows into a coherent mobile-native layout — 2x2 telemetry grid, no horizontal overflow, status block prioritised at top — while A ships a genuine mobile defect (nav link clipped mid-word, desktop-scale hero eating ~35% of the viewport) and on desktop reads as an unstyled GitHub-Pages template with flat red incident cards, axis-less sparklines, and inconsistent link treatment.
